verdict.rationale: Twenty offers the building blocks needed: an MCP server and GraphQL/REST API exposing deals, companies, and people (twenty-docs-32, twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-22), automatic email/calendar sync to CRM records (twenty-docs-4, twenty-docs-52, twenty-docs-58), and permission-scoped AI agents that can query and enrich records autonomously (twenty-docs-5, twenty-docs-18, twenty-docs-56, twenty-docs-19). However, there's no documented pre-built 'account brief' template or workflow combining these into a single meeting-prep output — it would require custom agent/workflow assembly — and community feedback flags rough edges ('pretty alpha-version... ran into quite a few small issues') that tempers confidence in production reliability.
